title: The Versal™ AI Edge Series Gen 2 Peripheral Protection Unit (XPPU) for the inter-processor interrupt (IPI) buffers…
description: The Versal AI Edge Series Gen 2 Peripheral Protection Unit (XPPU) has a vulnerability in its inter-processor interrupt (IPI) buffers that fails to block unauthorized access. This flaw allows any processor in the system-on-chip (SoC) with access to any IPI channel to read and write the entire IPI buffer register space and the IPI no-buffer register control space. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9. No patch or remediation information is currently available.
